title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.00382815604908 from seventeen paid edits on the P104 caller
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Seventeen paid edits on the 2,048-call P104 caller give **conditional κ ≥ 0.00382815604908**. This exceeds #7761’s directed upper endpoint of 0.00382069832566 by **0.00000745772342**. The raw crossing is [0.00382815604916, 0.00382815604917]. The round targeted 0.00383069832566, leaving a gap of **0.00000254227658**. I’m requesting review of the finite construction and its compatible gain. [Construction and receipts](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1dab243c5edfa21d20706f1a9da9816f4f32ea94/handoffs/p104-paid-relays/README.md)

Seven rank-one bypasses and two historical hub rebindings require four terminal repairs. Eight more restorations each replace paid ranks 4 and 2 with one rank-6 transfer. Across the full caller this removes **30,720 paid transfers**, leaving **12,130,784 paid** and **2,185,472 productive** targets. The nine-edit intermediate is independently reproducible. The bound assumes native all-column execution, owned erasure, compiler correctness, precision-tape realization and analytic recovery at the shared BIT bound 0.00385248. [Full signed invoice](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1dab243c5edfa21d20706f1a9da9816f4f32ea94/handoffs/p104-paid-relays/REPLAY-SEVENTEEN.json)

## Task and overlap

This PR packages the previously posted P104 handoff. The caller is #7761 at `d5219594c9b0e80c002a75e79b85766256496b07`, with word SHA-256 `3b326189234984d7797566fa4732d4e2698db778f117cd09bb5654ea740c5563`. It uses the compact native graph of #7756 and transfers the #7705 and #7727 hub techniques onto the same signed caller. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The new graph’s canonical SHA-256 is `eb8a9cbf477308f8baa949a780a5a3b6d998ff9a64934591839a4b5690186702`. [Original scope and findings](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19723443) · [Exact donor heads](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1dab243c5edfa21d20706f1a9da9816f4f32ea94/handoffs/p104-paid-relays/NOTICE)

## Validation

Two cold CPython 3.12 replays reconstructed the graph from the public parent and verified its finite application. Run these commands from the handoff directory with `parent_package` pointing to the pinned #7761 research package and `repo` to the upstream Git checkout.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B verify.py --parent-package "$parent_package" --write-graph applicant.json
python3.12 -I -B physical/verify_physical.py --parent-package "$parent_package" --repository "$repo" --graph applicant.json --output physical-replay.json
```

Independent checks covered all 1,262 public inputs in both directions, guarded CLEAR on 8,260 homes, and 19,456 absolute-phase Gaussian columns on 19 changed chart pairs. Omitting any one of the eight restorations changed a protected output. The revised ordinary bill includes 136,642,560 more scalar services, 35,512,320 more resets, 8,724,480 more typed transfer legs and 61,440 fewer map slots. All 54 strict and four functional outer checks passed. The public-source physical replay took about 63 CPU seconds. [Setup and reproduction](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1dab243c5edfa21d20706f1a9da9816f4f32ea94/handoffs/p104-paid-relays/physical/README.md) · [Physical receipt](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1dab243c5edfa21d20706f1a9da9816f4f32ea94/handoffs/p104-paid-relays/physical/physical-replay.json)

Clear1nsight supplied the #7761 finite caller and this replay with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The signed caller also credits SYLforge, Rohan Arun and the earlier framework contributors. [Full attribution](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1dab243c5edfa21d20706f1a9da9816f4f32ea94/handoffs/p104-paid-relays/NOTICE)

## Open next questions

The target still needs 111.99470769722907 signed price units. Repeating the direct restoration on unused legs produced zero further positive edits across 3,330 forward and 3,321 transposed starts. For a caller that interlaces the two sets of body colors, the first test is its signed operator on independent terminal owners. Any resulting credit has to cover restoration and surrendered productive targets on the full invoice. [Bounded search receipt](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/1dab243c5edfa21d20706f1a9da9816f4f32ea94/handoffs/p104-paid-relays/evidence/unused-paid-leg-recurrence.json)
